about: Platform limits UMS checks posts and videos against. Each value records where it came from. verified=true means it was read on the platform's own page on the date given; verified=false means only third-party or snippet evidence was found, so UMS treats it as a warning rather than a hard stop where it can. Refresh with the research in references/research.md before relying on a value for a paid campaign.

loudness.note: No platform publishes an organic upload loudness target. -14 LUFS integrated with -1 dBTP true peak is UMS's working target because it survives every feed's normalisation without pumping. Google's DV360 ad spec is -24 LKFS +/-2, which applies to ads only.

links.note: API posts with a URL cost $0.20 against $0.015 without (docs.x.com pricing, read 2026-11-25), and outside analyses report far lower reach for link posts, which X denies. Put the link in the first reply.

video.note: API limits: 20 minutes and 8 GB by default; 125 minutes and 16 GB for Premium. 16:9 and 1:1 also play well.

links.note: Links are rich-text facets and do not reduce distribution.

hashtags.note: Threads takes one topic tag per post.
